plain_summary_en: This paper studies Visions of Visual Journalism in AI-Futures. In plain terms, it asks what is happening, why it matters for public communication, and what evidence the authors use. The likely focus is visual journalism, artificial intelligence, future of journalism, AI-generated images. The abstract suggests a mixed methods approach, which makes the work useful for understanding how communication changes in everyday life.
